title: A line priced before tiers keeps its margin when received at a new cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging, where data from before the release is kept; the QA site only if its data predates the release; the production test account only if neither has data from before the release.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a work order on staging open since before the release, with a special-order part not yet received, priced before the release (for example cost $100.00, sell $135.00).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open that work order.
  2. Open the part's Receive Part window.
  3. Type double the part's cost in Received Cost (for example 200.00).
  4. Click Receive.
  5. Point at the part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • Receive Part opens.

Step 3:

  • Received Cost reads the new cost.

Step 4:

  • The sell price doubles too, keeping the margin (for example $200.00 ÷ (1 − 0.2593) = $270.00).

Step 5:

  • The details still read "Priced before tiers".
